classification.difficultyReason: Construct and graph two contextual linear relationships, verify their intersection and interpret it in the race.

inlines.text: Jessica and Max have a 10-second running race.
Jessica is given a 10 m head start and runs at 4 m/s.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Plot these points on a distance–time graph and join them to form two straight lines, labelling them ‘Jessica’ and ‘Max’.

spec.description: First-quadrant plotting grid with source x and y axis labels, no origin label and no supplied plots.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal range 0 to 10, grid step 1, labelled ticks 1 to 10. Vertical range 0 to 60, grid step 5, labelled ticks 10 to 60.

answer.short: Max: $d=6t$. Jessica: $d=10+4t$. The lines intersect at $(5,30)$.
answer.worked: Plot the values from the table and join each athlete’s points with a straight line. Max’s line runs from $(0,0)$ to $(10,60)$; Jessica’s line runs from $(0,10)$ to $(10,50)$. They intersect at $(5,30)$.

spec.description: Completed source coordinate grid with both athletes’ points joined and lines labelled. Blue and red distinguish the two authored series.
spec.mathematics: Max d=6t and Jessica d=10+4t for 0<=t<=10; intersection (5,30).

children.label: c
children.prompt: Write the solution $(t,d)$ that is true for both distance equations and show that it satisfies both equations.

answer.worked:
The graphs intersect at $(t,d)=(5,30)$.

Max:
$$\begin{align*}d&=6t\\&=6(5)\\&=30\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
Jessica:
$$\begin{align*}d&=10+4t\\&=10+4(5)\\&=30\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
Both equations give $d=30$ m when $t=5$ s.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Explain what is happening in the race at the point of intersection, and for each athlete state the distance from the starting line and time taken.

answer.short: After 5 s, both athletes are 30 m from the starting line. Max catches up with and passes Jessica.
answer.worked: At the intersection, both athletes have the same distance at the same time. After 5 s, Max and Jessica are each 30 m from the starting line. Max catches Jessica there and then passes her because he runs faster.
